name: K-space subsampling for low-resolution generation
definition: Generates a low-resolution volume from a high-resolution volume by subsampling the central region of its 3D Fourier transform (k-space) and reconstructing via inverse transform.
summary: K-space subsampling generates low-resolution volumes by cropping the central low-frequency region of the 3D Fourier transform, preserving structural information while discarding high-frequency details.
